item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors. item.description: We invite you to submit a paper or a book review to the journal Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro, edited by the Department of Linguistics of the Faculty of Letters (University of Bucharest) in collaboration with Bucharest University Press. TAL@ro is designed as a comprehensive and dynamic platform aimed at sparking debates and facilitating dialogue among scholars in various linguistic disciplines (e.g. phonetics, morphology, syntax, lexicology, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, etc.
